name: pig-wander
comment: WP-2.2. A pig in a fenced 15x15 pen: stone platform y = 60 over -8..8, its west half (x -8..-1) grass, fences (id 85, 1.5 high) at y = 61 on the rim. EntityCreature.updatePlayerActionState with no target: each tick a 1-in-100 roll leaves a path for EntityLiving's idle AI (2 % new target / random yaw speed, 5 % new yaw speed), and with no path a 1-in-80 (twice) roll runs updateWanderPath: ten random cells, getBlockPathWeight (EntityAnimal: 10 on grass, else the light brightness - 0.5), World.getEntityPathToXYZ (ChunkCache, Pathfinder) to the best; the pig turns at most 30 degrees a tick toward the next point and walks at moveSpeed 0.7 (moveEntityWithHeading, ground friction 0.546, moveFlying 0.1 * 0.16277136 / f^3), jumps when the next point is higher or it is blocked; the fences stop it (the path may lead over a fence: the cell above it is free). The living sound timer draws rand.nextInt(1000) every tick. rng_state and entity_state every tick.
